researcher_exposure_disclosure.execution_guard: Stage 1 and stage 2 installed a sys.addaudithook file-open guard that aborts the process if any file under evaluation/portfolio/ outside the frozen BEFORE document and this run's own output directory is opened. withdrawn_review_proposal.description: Before the review was executed, the reviewing agent incorrectly reported that Phase 3 had left steps[4].capability_signals.creates_new_content unknown, and proposed correcting it to true. The user approved that proposal. The stage 2 precondition check then established that Phase 3 had already identified the signal as true with resolved evidence, so no correction was applied.
withdrawn_review_proposal.cause: The reviewing agent read a truncated diagnostic dump and inferred the missing value rather than re-reading the artefact.
withdrawn_review_proposal.relevance: The withdrawn proposal concerned the signal most likely to align with the documented AFTER intervention. It is disclosed because it is exactly the class of reviewer error that AFTER-exposure could bias, even though the frozen artefacts were never affected.

researcher_exposure_disclosure.mitigation: The Phase 4 record contains zero corrections, zero rejections and zero conflict resolutions. Every event is an accept of a source-supported assertion or an explicit retention of an unknown, so no reviewer judgement altered the extracted content that the deterministic engine consumed. Prior exposure is nevertheless retained as a limitation and reviewer blindness is not claimed.
